parsed.main_gap: The terminal-set cardinality bound uses a false inequality, though correcting the exponent immediately repairs the proof.

errors.description: There are |D|-1 factors in w(D\{p}), so only 2^{|D|-1} ≤ w(D\{p}) is justified. This still bounds |D| and makes the remainder valid.
